Current proposal:
> Verify that system administrators cannot change or choose any user's password, but rather can only initiate the password reset process for the user.

I think it requires further changes:
* switch "negative + positive" requirement to "positive + negative" requirement
* "system administrator" is maybe not precise, if there is UI for password reset, it is just one user with certain privileges for managing users, I would not call this user as "system administrator". So I propose "administrative user"
* add actual goal into the requirement text: administrative user do not know the password for the user after the process
